user.title: Step 1 of 5 · Robots
user.description: Create one planner for an apartment, floor, or robot fleet.

presence.title: Step 2 of 5 · Conditions
presence.description: Select people, trackers, occupancy sensors, or numeric counters such as the Home zone. Numeric zero means empty; values above zero mean somebody is home. A waiting mission starts automatically when every selected entity reports empty.

schedule.title: Step 3 of 5 · First schedule
schedule.description: Choose the robot and timing for the first run. The next step reads the live cleaning choices exposed by that robot. In the Advanced Card you can later create a different profile for every weekday. An optional Home Assistant Schedule helper overrides weekdays and time.

data.people_home: When somebody is home (wait / allow / skip)

profile.title: Step 4 of 5 · Robot profile
profile.description: Live choices detected for {vacuum} via {adapter}. Unsupported settings stay hidden and the available values follow the robot entities.

services.title: Step 5 of 5 · Connections
services.description: Notifications work without configuration and appear in Home Assistant. Advanced users can select a compatible central router script. The optional route helper contributes its current value, for example mobile, family, or persistent.

abort.already_configured: These vacuum cleaners are already managed by a planner.

error.no_vacuums: Select at least one vacuum cleaner.

init.title: Configure planner
init.description: Change connections and conditions, create another mission, or select any existing mission to edit it.

data.options_action: What do you want to configure?

connections.title: Connections & conditions
connections.description: Notifications require no configuration. Select a router script only if Home Assistant already uses a compatible central notification script. The route helper's current value is passed as route.

mission_schedule.title: Mission · Schedule & conditions
mission_schedule.description: Every saved mission remains available here after initial setup. Select its robot, timing and behavior, then continue to the live robot profile.

mission_profile.title: Mission · Robot profile
mission_profile.description: Live choices detected for {vacuum} via {adapter}. Saving updates this mission immediately.

delete_mission.title: Delete mission?
delete_mission.description: Permanently delete {mission}. This does not remove the vacuum or planner.

error.no_vacuums: Select at least one vacuum cleaner.
error.mission_not_found: The selected mission no longer exists.
